content.user_title: Automate Test Strategy and Quality Engineering
content.value_statement: Teams often struggle to choose the right test coverage, tools, and CI/CD quality gates. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan practical automation strategies.
actual_capabilities: Designs test automation strategies for web, mobile, API, and performance testing.
Guides TDD workflows using red, green, refactor cycles and test-first planning.
Recommends frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Appium, K6, JMeter, and Pact.
Plans CI/CD quality gates, parallel execution, smoke tests, and reporting flows.
Advises on test data management, privacy controls, and environment cleanup.
Defines quality metrics for coverage, stability, execution time, and team adoption.
limitations: It provides guidance and plans, not a ready-made test framework.
It does not execute tests or inspect application behavior by itself.
Tool recommendations require validation against each team stack and budget.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in the scanned file tree.

use_cases.title: Plan Automation Coverage
use_cases.description: Create a balanced test pyramid with unit, integration, API, UI, and performance checks.

use_cases.title: Improve TDD Practice
use_cases.description: Structure red, green, refactor cycles and track test-first adoption across a team.

use_cases.title: Build CI/CD Quality Gates
use_cases.description: Select tests for pipelines, define thresholds, and organize reporting for release confidence.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Test Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new feature or service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a test automation plan for this feature. Include test levels, tools, data needs, and release gates.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Frameworks
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate tool selection for a known stack.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare suitable automation frameworks for our stack. Explain tradeoffs for UI, API, mobile, and performance testing.

prompt_templates.title: Design TDD Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a TDD workflow for this module. Include failing tests, minimal implementation steps, refactoring checks, and metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Scale Quality Gates
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a scalable CI/CD testing strategy. Include dynamic test selection, parallel execution, reporting, thresholds, and maintenance rules.

output_examples.input: Design a test automation strategy for a microservices platform.
output: A layered test pyramid with service contract tests as the main integration control.
Pipeline stages for unit, contract, API, smoke, performance, and canary validation.
A reporting plan that tracks stability, duration, coverage gaps, and escaped defects.

output_examples.input: Help us adopt TDD for a payment workflow.
output: A first failing test for the highest-risk payment rule.
Small implementation steps that preserve fast feedback.
Refactoring checks and metrics for cycle time, failure quality, and test growth.

output_examples.input: Create a CI quality gate plan for browser tests.
output: A browser coverage matrix focused on customer risk and supported platforms.
Parallel execution groups with retry limits and flaky test triage.
Release thresholds for smoke pass rate, accessibility checks, and visual regressions.

best_practices: Start with risk-based coverage before adding broad end-to-end suites.
Keep tests independent, readable, and tied to clear product behavior.
Track stability, execution time, defect escape rate, and maintenance cost.
anti_patterns: Do not automate every manual test without reviewing value and maintenance cost.
Do not rely only on UI tests for business logic coverage.
Do not store real customer data or long-lived credentials in test fixtures.

faq.question: Does this skill write complete test code?
faq.answer: It can guide test design and implementation steps. Final code should be adapted to the project stack.

faq.question: Which testing tools does it cover?
faq.answer: It references Playwright, Selenium, Appium, Postman, REST Assured, K6, JMeter, Pact, axe-core, and related tools.

faq.question: Can it help with TDD?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports failing test design, red-green-refactor cycles, refactoring checks, and TDD adoption metrics.

faq.question: Can it design CI/CD quality gates?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan pipeline stages, dynamic test selection, thresholds, reporting, and release validation.

faq.question: Does it replace QA engineers?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning and analysis, while engineers validate risks, tools, and implementation details.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated data?
faq.answer: It includes privacy and test data guidance. Teams must still apply their own compliance controls.
